seo.seo_title: Websites for businesses in Boden | Norden Media UF
seo.seo_description: We build websites that get found on Google and win more customers, and handle domain, email and hosting. Fixed price, and you only pay when you are happy.

hero.t1: Local web agency in the north
hero.t4: We build websites that show who you are, get found on Google and bring in more customers. Then we take care of everything, from hosting to updates.

pay_when_you_are_happy.t11: You only pay when you are happy.
pay_when_you_are_happy.t12: We finish the work and show you the result. We only send the invoice once you have approved it. No upfront payment, no risk.

before_and_after.t21: No website, or one that nobody finds
before_and_after.t22: You show up where customers look
before_and_after.t23: We make sure you can be found on Google, Google Maps and AI services such as ChatGPT when someone searches for what you offer.
before_and_after.t24: A website that no longer reflects you
before_and_after.t25: A website that shows who you are
before_and_after.t26: We get to know your business and build a website with your tone, your images and what makes you unique. Customers understand right away why they should choose you.
before_and_after.t27: Visitors who leave without getting in touch
before_and_after.t29: Clear offers, fast pages and simple paths to contact, booking or purchase turn more visitors into customers.
before_and_after.t30: Bookings and reminders handled by hand
before_and_after.t32: Customers book directly on your website and receive confirmations and reminders automatically. Every booking is saved in your customer register.
before_and_after.t34: Every month you get a short report on visits and enquiries, with suggestions for what we will improve next. Included in Sarek and Kebne.

who_we_are.t37: We are three students at Björknäsgymnasiet who run Norden Media UF together with Ung Företagsamhet (Junior Achievement Sweden). You reach us directly, get quick answers and skip the technical detours. Every client is a reference for us, so we make sure it is done right.
who_we_are.t39_alt: The team behind Norden Media UF: three people in black t-shirts in front of a light wall

what_we_do.t42: We take full responsibility, from the first sketch to day-to-day operations. You get a finished solution, not more things to keep track of.
what_we_do.t44: With booking, contact forms and customer login when needed.
what_we_do.t46: Email addresses on your own domain, set up and managed by us.
what_we_do.t48: SEO, optimisation for AI answers and a Google Business Profile.
what_we_do.t50: Confirmations, reminders and mailings that go out automatically.
what_we_do.t52: We keep everything running, secure and up to date.

how_it_works.t56: You tell us what you need, and we take care of the rest. It usually takes three to six weeks from the first call to launch. How fast it goes depends on the size of your website and how quickly we receive material from you. After launch we stay on and look after everything.
how_it_works.t59: We get to know your business, your customers and how you work today. Then we know what the website needs to contain and what will make the biggest difference.
how_it_works.t61: You get a fixed price for the build and a clear monthly fee, with what is included. Based on what you want, you get a short form about the content to fill in. After launch you can always change all the content yourselves, easily through your customer portal.
how_it_works.t63: We write the copy, build the website on a test address that only you can see and connect the systems. You can follow the work all the way.
how_it_works.t65: You review and approve the website. Then we move your web address and email and publish it, so you show up on Google from day one.
how_it_works.t67: We keep the website running, secure and up to date, and help you whenever something needs changing. With the Sarek and Kebne packages you also get a monthly report with suggested improvements.

after_the_uf_year.t71: A UF student company runs for one school year, but working with us does not have to end there. Our plan is to continue the business as a limited company, with the same people and the same service, for every client who wants to stay.
after_the_uf_year.t72: The website and all its content belong to you.
after_the_uf_year.t73: If you would rather move on, we hand over all the material and help you move to another provider, so the switch is smooth.

we_also_stream_live.t76: So more people can take part.
we_also_stream_live.t77: Conferences, lectures, AGMs and ceremonies. We bring the equipment and run the cameras, sound and graphics, while you focus on the programme.
we_also_stream_live.t79: Name titles, logo and slides on screen
we_also_stream_live.t80: To your website, YouTube and social media at once
we_also_stream_live.t84_alt: Audience at an event at Boden Business Park, with a speaker on stage and a presentation on a large screen
we_also_stream_live.t86_alt: Video camera with a monitor filming a conversation on stage

faq.t90: You pay a fixed start-up cost for the build itself, from SEK 3,495, then a monthly fee from SEK 195 for hosting, updates and support. All prices exclude VAT. Live streaming is quoted per event.
faq.t93: Only when the website is finished and you are happy with it. The start-up cost is invoiced once you have approved the finished website, and the monthly fee starts when the website goes live.
faq.t94: What happens when the UF year ends?
faq.t95: Our plan is to continue the business as a limited company, with the same people and the same service, for the clients who want to stay. The website and its content belong to you, so if you would rather move on, we hand over all the material and help you move to another provider.
faq.t97: Usually three to six weeks from the first call to launch, depending on the size of the website and how quickly we receive material from you.
faq.t99: Do we need to know anything about tech?
faq.t100: No. You tell us what you want and we handle the rest. Everything is explained in plain language.
faq.t101: We have no website at all. Is that a problem?
faq.t102: Not at all. We start from scratch and take care of everything, from domain and email to a finished website that shows up on Google.
faq.t103: Can you take over our old website, domain and email?
faq.t104: Yes. We move your domain, DNS and email for you and plan the move so that you lose neither email nor your rankings on Google.
faq.t107: More and more people search using AI services such as ChatGPT and Google's AI Overviews. We structure the content on your website so that these services understand what you offer and can point customers to you.
